def monthly_total(amounts: list[float]) -> float:
    """The month's total with tax, to the cent."""
    rate = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())["rate"]

    adjusted_rate = rate / 10
    return round(sum(amounts) * (1 + adjusted_rate), 2)
